summary: Clearway Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, disclosing entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement with multiple agents, allowing issuance of up to $100 million of Class C common stock at market prices through an ATM program. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine at-the-market shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration statement, not a special-situation event. No deal terms beyond the offering size are stated.
